sources.title: eousphoros/qwen3.8-27b-yarn4-mixed-kl-128k-r1-iter137-fp8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is an experimental blockwise-FP8 derivative of eousphoros/qwen3.8-27b-yarn4-mixed-kl-128k-r1-iter137. The source model merges a LoRA/direct-normalization calibration into Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B for static YaRN with a factor of 4.0. sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B - GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.snippet: 27B-parameter dense hybrid-attention model with linear attention on 48 of 64 layers, a vision tower, a built-in MTP draft head, 262K native context window and extensible to 1M context

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B | NVIDIA NGC
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a 27-billion-parameter dense vision-language model for text, image, and video understanding. It supports coding, professional-work and research workflows, multimodal reasoning, configurable thinking depth, long-context processing, tool calling, and multi-step agentic tasks.
